commentary.text: 90+4' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+2' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Wissam Ben Yedder leaves the pitch and Myron Boadu (Monaco) comes on.
90+1' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
90' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but Philipp Kohn easily deals with the threat.
90' The ball possession at the moment is 76:24.
89' The game has come to an end for Folarin Balogun. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Edan Diop (Monaco).
85' A corner kick by Monaco is thwarted by the well prepared Alexandre Oukidja (Metz).
84' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Alexandre Oukidja thwarts him with a nice save.
84' Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.

83' Joel Asoro (Metz) is picked out by one of his teammates with a brilliant low pass, but he doesn't control the ball well and the defence eliminates the danger without any problem. That should have been a goalscoring opportunity.
79' Substitution. Eliesse Ben Seghir (Monaco) has come on for Takumi Minamino.
78' Monaco take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
77' Metz take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
75' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) slips past one challenge, but is unable to feed a low pass into the path of one of his teammates.
74' The referee is firm and issues Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) a deserved yellow card.
73' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and floats high over the bar.
73' Monaco work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
71' Laszlo Boloni prepares a substitution. Cheikh Sabaly is replaced by Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz).
71' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Arthur Atta (Metz) is coming onto the pitch as Lamine Camara cannot continue after picking up an injury.
70' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards over the bar.
67' Chrislain Matsima (Monaco) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.

67' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) finds himself some space around the penalty spot and leaps high to meet the free kick. He tries to put his header into the middle of the goal, but Alexandre Oukidja keeps it out.
66' Benjamin Tetteh (Metz) sees a yellow card. He should be more careful because one more challenge like that could result in a red card.
66' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
63' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) tested Alexandre Oukidja with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
61' Substitution. Joel Asoro (Metz) in, Ablie Jallow out.
60' The ball goes behind for a corner. Monaco will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
59' Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
59' A pass from Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is intercepted by Alexandre Oukidja and the move breaks down.
55' 2 - 1 Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) proves that he is an excellent free-kick taker after finding the back of the net with a clever shot that goes straight into the bottom right corner!
54' Lamine Camara (Metz) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
52' Lamine Camara (Metz) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
51' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
49' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) goes close to scoring with a shot from inside the box, but he drags his effort wide of the left post.
46' Substitution. Mohamed Camara did his best and is replaced by Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco).
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
42' 1 - 1 Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) finds some space on the edge of the penalty box and smashes the ball into the top right corner! What a beauty!
40' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.
40' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance. Monaco force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Monaco can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
36' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
33' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monaco comes to nothing.
32' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Benjamin Tetteh (Metz) comes onto the pitch for Oscar Estupinan.
30' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
29' Oscar Estupinan (Metz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
26' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Alexandre Oukidja anticipates well and smothers the ball.
25' Danley Jean Jacques (Metz) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
23' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.

21' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) produces a long-range cannon of a shot after a nice pass. The ball heads towards the middle of the goal, but is easily stopped by a save from Alexandre Oukidja and the score remains the same.
19' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
17' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.

17' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Alexandre Oukidja makes a brilliant save! The linesman points to the corner flag, Monaco are going to take it.
15' Ablie Jallow (Metz) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
13' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) wins the ball from the corner and heads at goal from near the penalty spot, but it's a soft effort and drifts well past the left post.
12' Monaco will take a corner kick.
10' Krepin Diatta (Monaco) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
8' Mohamed Camara (Monaco) gets a shot from distance but fails to generate enough power to beat the goalkeeper.
7' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) sends a lofted cross into the penalty area. Unfortunately for him, the opponent's defence deals with his cross comfortably and intercepts it.
4' A mix up in midfield presents the ball to Lamine Camara (Metz) and he coolly lobs a stranded Philipp Kohn from distance to make the score 0:1.
4' Some neat passing and movement from Monaco as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
3' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
1' The first half has started.
Monaco will kick the game off.
Romain Lissorgue was nominated as the referee for this game.
